title: Family Calendar Load and Clash Detection
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`).
app: Baby-tracking apps (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook exports), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, and growth logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=family:calendar
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(person) as people by _time
| eval busy=if(events>6,1,0)
| sort - events
description: Counts everyone's events per day to spot the over-scheduled days before the family logistics collapse.
value: Modern family calendars overflow silently; a daily load view flags the impossible days early enough to reschedule something.
implementation: Ingest shared calendar events into `index=personal`; schedule daily and flag over-full days.
visualization: Column chart of daily family events with a busy threshold.
grandmaExplanation: It counts everyone's activities each day to spot the over-busy days before the family runs itself ragged.
